summary: Tables should read left to right and top to bottom, include a heading row, avoid empty cells, and have a descriptive title, with RST and Markdown examples.
questions: How should tables be formatted in Ansible docs?
How do I give a table a title in RST?

answer_card.title: Tables
answer_card.answer_md:
Include a header row, no empty cells, simple reading order and a descriptive title.
```rst
.. table:: File descriptions

  +----------+----------------------------+
  |File      |Purpose                     |
  +==========+============================+
  |foo.txt   |foo configuration settings  |
  +----------+----------------------------+
```
In Markdown, put a `####` title above a pipe table.
